import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

# Data
methods =      ['Binoculars', 'FastDetectGPT', 'LD-Score', 'Avg-LogProb', '7-Feature Ensemble']
macro_f1 =     [0.579,         0.627,           0.721,      0.765,          0.798]
ci_lo =        [0.405,         0.511,           0.588,      0.616,          0.786]
ci_hi =        [0.664,         0.762,           0.770,      0.820,          0.799]

# Derived
ci_width = [hi - lo for lo, hi in zip(ci_lo, ci_hi)]
err_lo = [m - lo for m, lo in zip(macro_f1, ci_lo)]
err_hi = [hi - m for m, hi in zip(macro_f1, ci_hi)]

# Okabe-Ito colors
ensemble_color = '#0072B2'  # deep blue
single_color = '#999999'    # gray
colors = [single_color] * 4 + [ensemble_color]

y_pos = np.arange(len(methods))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4.5))

# Vertical dashed line at ensemble mean
ax.axvline(x=0.798, color=ensemble_color, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.5, zorder=1)

# CI bars + dots
for i in range(len(methods)):
    lw = 2.5 if i == len(methods) - 1 else 1.8
    ms = 9 if i == len(methods) - 1 else 7
    zord = 4 if i == len(methods) - 1 else 3
    
    # CI bar
    ax.plot([ci_lo[i], ci_hi[i]], [y_pos[i], y_pos[i]],
            color=colors[i], linewidth=lw, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=zord)
    # CI caps
    cap_h = 0.15
    ax.plot([ci_lo[i], ci_lo[i]], [y_pos[i] - cap_h, y_pos[i] + cap_h],
            color=colors[i], linewidth=lw, zorder=zord)
    ax.plot([ci_hi[i], ci_hi[i]], [y_pos[i] - cap_h, y_pos[i] + cap_h],
            color=colors[i], linewidth=lw, zorder=zord)
    # Dot
    ax.plot(macro_f1[i], y_pos[i], 'o', color=colors[i], markersize=ms,
            markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.8, zorder=zord + 1)

# CI width annotations (right side)
for i in range(len(methods)):
    ax.text(ci_hi[i] + 0.012, y_pos[i], f'CI width: {ci_width[i]:.3f}',
            va='center', ha='left', fontsize=8.5,
            color=colors[i], fontweight='bold' if i == len(methods) - 1 else 'normal')

# Significance markers
for i in range(len(methods) - 1):
    ax.text(macro_f1[i], y_pos[i] + 0.32, '***', ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontsize=8, color='#555555')

# Axis config
ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax.set_yticklabels(methods)
# Bold the ensemble label
labels = ax.get_yticklabels()
labels[-1].set_fontweight('bold')
labels[-1].set_color(ensemble_color)

ax.set_xlabel('Macro-F1')
ax.set_xlim(0.35, 0.92)
ax.set_ylim(-0.6, len(methods) - 0.4)

ax.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.2, zorder=0)

# Annotation: significance note
ax.text(0.98, 0.02, '*** $p < 0.001$ (bootstrap)',
        transform=ax.transAxes, ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=8.5,
        color='#555555', style='italic')

# Annotation: ensemble reference line label
ax.text(0.798 + 0.005, len(methods) - 0.5, 'Ensemble\nmean',
        fontsize=8, color=ensemble_color, alpha=0.7, va='top')

plt.tight_layout()

import os
os.makedirs('/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/figures', exist_ok=True)
plt.savefig('/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/figures/fig3_baseline_comparison.pdf')
plt.savefig('/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/figures/fig3_baseline_comparison.png')
plt.close()
print('DONE')
